protocol.author_decision: The discovery-order test goes on after the stop flag few_capped_allowance_in_edges of section 7, the only flag the pilot set. No change that this protocol or the revision allows lifts the stop; the test is the only direct test of the question of section 1; the decision was taken before any weight, constant, importance, score or crawl of the revision existed (revision section 13, amendment of 9 November 2026). It covers that flag only (decision_covers), so every other refusal of section 8 stays.

statements: Ordered by C-PR on the contracts read so far, a crawl from a random contract of the giant strongly connected component reached the contracts of the universe with the most user-account inflow and those with the most user-authorised value sooner than a breadth-first crawl, but not sooner than a crawl ordered by the number of contract backlinks.
